An unhurried approach

A session is a conversation

Some people prefer to begin with a familiar activity, while others want a more formal portrait. The photographer can discuss those preferences without promising identical results for every group.

A short list of preferences is more useful than a demand to repeat someone else’s finished image exactly. Discuss the setting and purpose in your own words.
